title: Make explain layer stack match runtime resolution (VC-201-062)
goal: explain_key reports Pack and Workspace layers (env > workspace > host > pack > bundled) but SusiConfig::load/get_or_bundled_default only resolve env > host > compile-time bundled: the active pack's config.default.json is never consulted for settings, no <ws>/.susi/config.json reader exists at runtime, and explain reports unparseable env values (e.g. SUSI_PORT_OFFSET=not-a-port) as effective where accessors parse-fail to the host value. Either implement the pack/workspace layers in the runtime resolver or strip them from explain so the reported origin is honest. Verified by crates/susi-config/src/tests/vc_201_062_mastery.rs.
